      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation updates (doc/design/private-broadcast.md and doc/private-broadcast.md) accompany the code implementation rather than serving as the primary change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Code changes that also update documentation belong to the primary functional area, not the docs category."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp mechanically as part of node network parameter usage without altering libbitcoinkernel APIs or boundaries.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical touches to kernel-compiled chain parameters do not affect the libbitcoinkernel boundary or API."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the P2P label and completely redesigns peer transaction broadcast isolation and connection handling across src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.82,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Eliminates critical privacy leaks and node crash vulnerabilities caused by coupling private broadcast state with CConnman and PeerManager. The rewrite isolates network jobs to protect 'against IP address linkage and not crashing the node on adversarial inputs (which is a leak in itself)'."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds new public RPC endpoints getprivatebroadcastinfo and abortprivatebroadcast in src/rpc/mempool.cpp.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.2,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces new RPC methods to inspect and manage isolated broadcast jobs, but without evidence of external consumer requests, new methods rank low in RPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in test files and harnesses test the private broadcast feature specifically rather than changing general test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning the behavior of a specific P2P subsystem belong to that area rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications in src/init.cpp solely wire startup and shutdown lifecycle management for the new private broadcast worker thread.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical initialization hookups for a domain-specific subsystem do not constitute a general utilities improvement."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Incidental touch in src/primitives/transaction.h does not alter transaction validity or consensus verification logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No consensus or chainstate validation invariants are modified."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
